title: Reversal in the Deadliest Predicament
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment Chen Ji and Ling Yuan reached a fragile truce, thousands of miles away, in the depths of a certain forbidden land, a pair of transcendent eyes slowly opened—the Eye of Heavenly Dao had already sensed the abnormal fluctuations of the Tianji Record.

text.content: That ancient and majestic voice thundered like nine heavens splitting open above the ruins of the Holy Sect. 'Boy, put her down, and this one will leave your corpse intact.' Before the words finished, an abyss-like aura had already enveloped the entire battlefield. Chen Ji felt as if ten thousand mountains pressed upon his shoulders; the unconscious Chen Nian in his arms nearly slipped from the terrifying pressure. He gritted his teeth, slightly bent his knees, and held his sister even tighter. The Grand Elder—a being at the apex of the cultivation world's pyramid, whose mere presence could shatter the courage of ordinary Golden Core cultivators.

In Chen Ji's Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice rang out: 'Master, this person's cultivation has reached Nascent Soul pinnacle, merely one step from Deification. Confronting directly offers no chance of victory.' Chen Ji coldly chuckled in his heart, yet his expression showed only panic—the废物 persona must not crumble. He raised his head, simulating a shivering appearance, and loudly declared: 'Senior, this junior merely follows orders! The one in my arms is my Chen family's bloodline, I beg the senior to show mercy!' This display of weakness was delivered so genuinely that even he nearly believed three parts of it.

Just then, a crack suddenly appeared in the heavens. A cyan sword light like a shooting star piercing the sun forcibly severed the Grand Elder's oppressive connection. As the sword light faded, a hunched yet imposing figure stood before Chen Ji—it was exactly Ling Yuan, the old patriarch of the Tianqing Sect. 'Ling Yuan?' The Grand Elder's voice carried more solemnity. 'Do you intend to make an enemy of the Holy Sect?' Ling Yuan chuckled, a cunning gleam flashing across his aged face: 'This old man merely came to take his sect's disciple home. Everyone, please continue.' Saying this, without turning his head, he murmured, 'Run, boy, quickly!'

Chen Ji did not move. He stared at Ling Yuan's back, his eyes flickering with sharp light. Why would this old fox appear at this moment? He knew Ling Yuan had long coveted his Tianji Record; this 'rescue' was likely far more dangerous than the Grand Elder's threat. But at present, the Grand Elder clearly would not let him leave. Chen Ji took a deep breath and made an unexpected move— he released Chen Nian, carefully placing her behind a sturdy rock, then slowly walked to stand beside Ling Yuan. 'Ling Ancestor,' his voice terrifyingly calm, 'this junior is willing to share weal and woe with the Tianqing Sect.'

A strange glint flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes. This废物 disciple's performance today was completely different from usual—that composure in the face of change, that decisiveness in instantly judging the situation—nothing a servant disciple should possess. But this was not the time for deeper investigation. He merely said calmly: 'Very well.' The Grand Elder coldly snorted: 'Ling Yuan, you truly intend to oppose this one? With just an old relic half-stepping into the grave?' Ling Yuan did not flare in anger but laughed instead, his laughter like a night owl's cry: 'An old relic? Hmph, let's see who the real废物 is.' He waved his sleeve, and a玄青色的 formation disk flew out, instantly resonating with some force within Chen Ji's body.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest as the Tianji Record Fragment reacted violently. Looking down, he saw the blue markings on his hand back resonating with Ling Yuan's formation disk, an unfamiliar yet powerful force flowing between the two. 'This is...' Ling Yuan's voice carried rare gravity. 'Chen family blood resonance? Boy, what exactly are you hiding in your body?' Chen Ji did not answer, because Mo Xiansheng's voice in the Tianji Record rang out again: 'Master, this is a rare opportunity! Your Chen family bloodline shares the same origin with Ling Yuan's. This resonance can temporarily unlock the deeper seals of the Tianji Record—but the price is, everything about you will be exposed under his perception!'

text.content: The Grand Elder clearly sensed this abnormality too. His brow furrowed tightly as he formed seals with both hands, a sky-obscuring black handprint pressing down toward the two of them. 'Whatever scheme you are plotting, today you both shall die!' The full-strength attack of Nascent Soul pinnacle made the entire void wail. Chen Ji knew this was the moment of life and death. The Tianji Record's foresight told him that confronting this attack head-on meant certain death; but using the blood resonance might offer a slim chance of survival. 'Ling Ancestor,' he suddenly spoke, his voice surprisingly calm, 'I need to borrow your hand.' Without waiting for Ling Yuan's response, Chen Ji had already proactively extended his hand, gripping that withered yet terrifyingly powerful palm.

choice.prompt: Blood Resonance Triggered! The joint attack between Chen Ji and Ling Yuan is about to begin, your choice:

choices.description: Go all in, inject all Heavenly Fate Value into the Tianji Record to trigger an unprecedented blood resonance effect, but will expose the Tianji Record's secrets to Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Unlock Hidden Tianji Record Ability: Bloodline Prophecy
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan Will glimpse part of the Tianji Record's secrets

text.content: The moment their palms touched, Chen Ji felt something within him completely ignite. It was the power sleeping deep within the Chen family bloodline, transformed into a raging wildfire under the Tianji Record's catalysis! Ling Yuan's pupils constricted sharply—he sensed it—this废物 disciple actually harbored bloodline power from the same source but far more pure than his own! 'You...' His voice trembled. But before he could finish, the Tianji Record Fragment had already floated out automatically, a brilliant golden light enveloping the two of them. It was power surpassing the current world's rules, a forbidden force even Heavenly Dao would turn to observe. The Grand Elder's expression finally changed.

'Bloodline Prophecy—Activate!' Chen Ji growled. He saw everything: all possibilities of past, present, and three seconds into the future. Within those three seconds, he found the only flaw in the Grand Elder's attack—a nearly imperceptible weak point in the lower-left of his dantian. 'Ling Ancestor, strike his left ribs!' Chen Ji shouted sharply. Ling Yuan did not hesitate; sword light like a dragon directly targeted that flaw. The Grand Elder, shocked and furious, was already too late to change his move—within a deafening roar, that sky-obscuring handprint was forcibly torn apart, and the Nascent Soul pinnacle expert was actually forced back three steps by two juniors!

'Excellent!' Ling Yuan laughed loudly, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying genuine recognition. 'Well done, boy! It turns out this old man has misjudged you all along!' Chen Ji did not heed his exclamation, because the Tianji Record's backlash had begun—splitting headaches, as if something was being extracted from the depths of his soul. But he did not stop; seizing the moment when the Grand Elder had not stabilized, he again activated the Tianji Record, shooting a golden talisman toward the enemy. 'This strike is to repay you for my sister!' The Grand Elder grunted, his chest pierced by the talisman, blood spurting wildly. He stared fixedly at Chen Ji, eyes full of disbelief, 'This... what kind of technique is this...'

At that moment, the Grand Elder's form suddenly blurred. He looked down at his chest wound, then at Chen Ji, his eyes flickering with fear and wariness. 'Today's matter, this one will remember.' His voice suddenly became distant. 'Chen family bloodline... Tianji Record... so that's how it is...' Before the words finished, his figure had already turned into black smoke and dissipated—he had actually torn through the void and fled. Chen Ji froze for a moment, then realized: the Grand Elder was afraid. This being standing at the apex of the cultivation world had actually been beaten away by a废物 disciple and a pile of old bones? Ling Yuan sheathed his sword and stood, his gaze toward Chen Ji complex and indecipherable: 'Boy, the things you exposed today are far more than you realize.'

choices.description: Suppress the scale of blood resonance, only borrow a small portion of Ling Yuan's power, maintaining a certain degree of secrecy
choices.visible_cost: May not fully withstand the attack
choices.risk_hint: The battle will be more difficult

text.content: Chen Ji chose a more stable path. He only allowed the blood resonance to maintain at its minimum threshold,既能借用凌渊的力量，又不会完全暴露自己的底牌。凌渊眉头微皱，显然察觉到了异样，但没有多说什么。两掌相握间，一股温和却精纯的力量流入陈机体内。"这个力量……"凌渊心中惊疑不定，这股血脉之力的精纯程度，竟不比他这个浸淫修行数百年的老家伙差多少。这小子究竟是什么来历？"

But limited strength was ultimately insufficient to completely resist the Elder's full-power strike. In the instant the massive black hand imprint pressed down, Chen Ji felt his five viscera and six organs violently trembling, blood nearly spewing from his mouth. "Boy!" Ling Yuan growled, sword light blazing, forcibly holding up half of that massive hand imprint. Yet even so, the overflowing pressure caused Chen Ji to stumble,狼狈地向后倒去。Just as this critical moment arrived, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace suddenly self-activated, a golden light covering his body—this was Mo Xiansheng acting at the crucial moment.

The golden light collided with the black hand imprint, producing an ear-piercing screech. A flash of greed appeared in the Elder's eyes: "What is that thing?" Ling Yuan抢先一步，挡在陈机身前，冷笑道："想抢东西？先问过老夫的剑！" He erupted with full force, sword light weaving, forcing the Elder into retreat. But Yuan Ying Peak was Yuan Ying Peak—even when forced back, he stabilized his position. "Ling Yuan, do you think this can protect him?" The Elder冷笑，"今日你们两个，一个都别想走！" Yet at this moment, several powerful auras suddenly arrived from the distance—the Tianqing Sect's other experts had arrived. The Elder's expression changed, and he decisively chose to retreat.

"Today's matter, this one will remember." The Elder's voice echoed in the void, "Chen family boy, your secret, this one will eventually excavate it!" Having said this, his figure vanished into the void. Chen Ji collapsed on the ground, gasping heavily. This battle, though won, was won too dangerously and too 狼狈. He looked up at Ling Yuan, only to find this old fox staring at him with a searching gaze. "Boy," Ling Yuan spoke, his voice carrying profound meaning, "The secrets on your body are even more numerous than this old man imagined." Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his face still maintained the terrified appearance of a废物: "Ling, Ling Ancestor, your disciple doesn't know what you're saying..." Ling Yuan roared with laughter, yet the laughter carried several layers of deeper meaning: "Keep pretending. This old man has lived for several hundred years—what kind of people haven't I seen?"

choices.description: Do not trust Ling Yuan, attempt to handle the Elder's attack alone

text.content: Chen Ji made a decision that shocked everyone—he fiercely shook off the hand Ling Yuan extended, coldly saying: "Ling Ancestor's kindness, your disciple accepts. But your disciple's affairs, your disciple resolves himself." Ling Yuan froze, then his expression darkened: "Boy, do you know what you're saying? That is a Yuan Ying Peak expert!" Chen Ji gave no answer, only slowly standing up, facing that world-blocking black hand imprint. His eyes held no fear, only a near-mad determination. The Tianji Record Fragment in his body疯狂转动，Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice响起："Master! Are you mad? At your current cultivation, this level of attack is absolutely impossible—"

"Nothing is impossible." Chen Ji低声。他双手结印，口中念念有词，the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly displayed countless dense runes. These runes he had never seen, yet at this moment he seemed to instinctively know how to use them. "Bloodline Forbidden Technique—Burn Heavenly Fate!" Chen Ji吼。In an instant, the Heavenly Fate in his body burned at an astonishing speed, transforming into a brilliant golden barrier. The black hand imprint collided with the golden barrier, producing a deafening roar. The clash of two forces triggered a violent energy storm, all structures within several li completely destroyed.

The Elder's expression slightly changed. He hadn't expected a mere Foundation Building junior to actually block his full-power strike. "Interesting..." He冷哼一声，increased attack intensity. The golden barrier began appearing cracks, Chen Ji's complexion turning deathly pale. "Master! Your Heavenly Fate is already overdrawn! Continue like this—" Mo Xiansheng's voice held rare urgency. But Chen Ji still did not retreat, his eyes burning with mad light: "I've walked the martial world这么多years, never relying on others! Today even if I die, I will make you pay the price!"

Just as the golden barrier was about to collapse, a sword light suddenly slashed from the side, forcibly slicing a crack in the black hand imprint. "Stupid boy, trying to die!" Ling Yuan's voice响起，carrying both annoyance and helplessness，"This old man said he'd take you home, you can't die!" He grabbed Chen Ji's arm, forcibly渡入bloodline power. "You..." Chen Ji愣住。Ling Yuan冷哼一声："Don't misunderstand, this old man isn't helping you, this old man just doesn't want Chen family's bloodline断在这里！" Two forces converged, finally blocking the Elder's attack. The Elder saw the situation turn unfavorable,冷笑一声："Ling Yuan, you intervened again. Fine, today I'll let you off. But the thing on that boy's body, this one will eventually obtain!"

The Elder's figure vanished into the void. Chen Ji collapsed on the ground, completely drained. Heavenly Fate nearly exhausted, the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea also dimmed. Ling Yuan居高临下地看着他，苍老的眼眸中闪烁着复杂的光芒。"Boy, you're stubborn enough." His voice was indecipherable，"But stubbornness doesn't fill the belly. Your performance today has attracted the Holy Sect's attention. What do you plan to do next?" Chen Ji lay on the ground,望着天空，bitter smile: "What else can I do? When soldiers come, use generals; when water comes, use earth. My life was picked up anyway." Ling Yuan沉默片刻，忽然蹲下身来，目光直视陈机的双眼："This old man gives you a choice—be this old man's chess piece, or this old man's enemy?"

The Elder was repelled, the entire battlefield falling into deathly silence. Those Tianqing Sect disciples originally eyeing with ulterior motives, now一个个噤若寒蝉，连大气都不敢出。Their god in their hearts—Yuan Ying Peak的Elder—actually被打跑了？This news if spread, the entire cultivation world would地震。But at this moment, no one had the mindset to contemplate these things, because they were all用惊骇的目光盯着那个倒在地上的年轻人。Chen Ji—the Tianqing Sect废物servant disciple,方才那一击的发起者。Ling Yuan sheathed his sword,目光复杂地看向陈机。This chess piece he always thought he could control at will, today displayed potential surpassing his control. "有意思..." he低声，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的笑容。

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan慢步走向陈机，居高临下地看这个躺在地上喘息不止的年轻人。"Chen Ji," he开口，声音中带着几分审视，"This old man asks you a few questions, you'd better answer truthfully." Chen Ji艰难地撑起身子，做出一副虚弱而惶恐的模样："Ling Ancestor请问，your disciple知无不言。" Ling Yuan冷笑一声："知无不言？你当老夫是三岁小孩？" He蹲下身，与陈机平视，"你体内的血脉之力从何而来？那道金光又是什么？还有你妹妹——她为什么能干扰天机录的预见？" Three questions, each pointing directly at the core. Chen Ji's heart tightened, yet his face still maintained废物惊恐的样子："Your disciple, your disciple really doesn't know..." Ling Yuan忽然笑了，那笑容让陈机感到一阵寒意："不知道？好一个不知道。那老夫换个问法——你愿意做老夫的盟友，还是敌人？"

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's probing was naked and direct, your choice:

choices.description: Temporarily ally with Ling Yuan, sharing partial intelligence but preserving core secrets
choices.visible_cost: Must regularly report progress to Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Ling Yuan's protection and partial intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may be using you

dialogue.content: Chen Ji垂下眼帘，做出一副深思熟虑后妥协的模样："Ling Ancestor说得对，your disciple如今势单力薄，若能有Tianqing Sect庇护，自然是求之不得。" Ling Yuan眯起眼睛，显然对这个回答并不完全满意，但也挑不出什么毛病。He伸出手："既然如此，击掌为誓——你我二人，在找到各自的答案之前，互不侵犯，互为盟友。" Chen Ji伸出手，与Ling Yuan击掌。掌心相触的瞬间，他感受到了一股强大的力量在试探他的经脉，但被他巧妙地引导化解了。Ling Yuan眼中闪过一丝异色：这个小子，反应倒是快得很。"很好，" he收回手，"From today, you are this old man's disciple. Anyone in Tianqing Sect who dares touch you is this old man's enemy."

"However," Ling Yuan话锋一转，"This old man has a favor to ask." Chen Ji心中冷笑，来了。This old fox果然不会平白无故帮他。"Ancestor please speak." Ling Yuan的目光落在不远处昏迷的陈念身上，眼中闪过一丝贪婪："你妹妹的血脉，似乎与天机录有某种联系。This old man wants to借她一用，study for a few days." Chen Ji的眼神瞬间冷了下来，但很快又恢复了那副唯唯诺诺的样子："Ancestor，妹妹她...身体不好，恐怕经不起折腾..." Ling Yuan摆摆手："放心，this old man自有分寸。不会伤她性命。" He说得轻描淡写，但Chen Ji却听出了其中的危险意味。这个老东西，果然是冲着陈念来的。

text.content: Chen Ji沉默片刻，忽然抬起头，露出一个人畜无害的笑容："Ancestor，your disciple大胆问一句——您研究妹妹的血脉，是想对付天机录，还是想对付别的什么人？" Ling Yuan眼眸微眯："你这话是什么意思？" Chen Ji轻声道："Your disciple方才观察到，Ancestor的阵盘与your disciple的血脉产生共鸣时，似乎有微弱的排斥反应。这种排斥...不是针对your disciple，而是针对your disciple身上的某种东西。" Ling Yuan脸色微变。Chen Ji继续说道："Your disciple大胆猜测，Ancestor您...也被某种力量注视着，对吗？" This sentence如同一把利刃，精准地刺中了Ling Yuan的要害。老掌门的脸上罕见地浮现出一丝动摇，随即被更深的阴沉所取代。"You know more than I imagined," he冷声道，"Then you should understand, some things, are not what you and I can provoke."

choices.description: Agreement only for cooperation against the Holy Sect, not involving core interests
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might exert covert pressure

text.content: Chen Ji thought for a moment, then displayed a sincere smile: "Senior Ling, your disciple has long admired you. It is my honor to serve you. However, I am merely a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, and many matters still depend on the sect's arrangements..." This speech concealed barbs beneath silk - ostensibly flattering, but actually implying: I can cooperate with you, but I am first and foremost a member of the Tianqing Sect, not your private soldier. Ling Yuan, being extremely shrewd, naturally discerned the underlying meaning. He narrowed his eyes, studying Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly smiled: "What a cunning young man." He stood with hands behind his back, "Very well, I won't force the issue. But remember, I saved your life today, and this favor must eventually be repaid."

"Thank you for your understanding, Senior." Chen Ji bowed respectfully, his posture impeccably deferential. Ling Yuan waved dismissively: "Don't thank me just yet. Saving you wasn't free." He withdrew a jade slip from his sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji. "This contains my years of investigation into the 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets.' Since you possess the Tianji Record, you should know what you're up against." Chen Ji received the jade slip, his heart jolting. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets - that was the name of the Tianji Record's ultimate BOSS. Ling Yuan was proactively sharing this intelligence? Was he trying to drag Chen Ji into his schemes, or did he have ulterior motives? "Of course," Ling Yuan shifted topics, "I'm not giving you this for free. If you discover any interesting leads during your investigation, remember to inform me immediately." As expected, this old fox never made a losing trade.

Chen Ji tucked the jade slip into his robes and said solemnly: "Disciple understands." Ling Yuan nodded, his gaze falling again on the unconscious Chen Nian: "Your sister..." He paused, seemingly choosing his words carefully, "Her bloodline is quite special. I've researched Chen family texts my entire life and never encountered such a physique." Chen Ji instinctively positioned himself protectively in front of Chen Nian. Observing this, Ling Yuan sneered: "Relax, I won't harm her. At least not now." His tone carried profound implications, "Her existence might unravel some mysteries that have long puzzled me. But that's for later." He turned to depart, yet suddenly stopped mid-stride, speaking without turning: "By the way, you'd best keep tonight's events buried deep. If others learned of any transaction between us..." The unspoken threat hung palpably in the air. "Disciple understands." Chen Ji replied deferentially. Only after Ling Yuan's silhouette completely vanished did Chen Ji slowly exhale, his back already drenched with cold sweat.

Mo Xiansheng's voice materialized in his Mental Sea: "Master, you acted wisely. Ling Yuan is an old schemer; allying with him is akin to dancing with wolves. Yet with your strength not yet restored, maintaining an ambiguous relationship might be your optimal choice." Chen Ji offered no retort, his gaze simply settling on the unconscious Chen Nian in his arms. His sister's breathing had steadied considerably, though that pallid complexion still wrenched his heart. "Heavenly Secrets' Eye..." he murmured to himself, "Turns out Ling Yuan's investigating this too." Retrieving the jade slip, his divine consciousness delved into its contents. With each passing line, his brow furrowed tighter - the intelligence within carried weight far beyond his initial expectations. What had Ling Yuan uncovered all these years? What untold entanglements bound him to the Heavenly Secrets' Eye?

Chen Ji gently brushed his fingers across Chen Nian's forehead. Her body temperature ran noticeably lower than a typical person's, a consequence of her "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" physique continuously draining her life force. Without finding a rescue method soon, she wouldn't survive beyond three months. "Niàn'ér, your brother will definitely save you," he whispered, lifting his sister and soaring toward the Tianqing Sect. The night wind bit at his face, chilling to the bone. So much had transpired tonight - the Elder's pursuit, Ling Yuan's unexpected appearance, the truth behind their blood resonance... Each event could reshape the entire cultivation realm's landscape. Now, all these clues converged toward a single point: the Heavenly Secrets' Eye. That transcendent consciousness, the entity treating all seers as mere chess pieces. Chen Ji lifted his gaze to the starless sky, a cold glint flickering in his eyes. "Thinking of making me a chess piece?" he said quietly, his voice laced with mockery, "Then let's see, in the end, who devours whom."

choice.prompt: With Ling Yuan's intelligence secured and Chen Nian temporarily safe, you face your next choice:

choices.text: Return to Tianqing Sect for rest and recovery
choices.description: Return to the sect to stabilize cultivation while secretly investigating Ling Yuan's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: Other factions might be monitoring within the sect

text.content: Chen Ji carried Chen Nian back to Tianqing Sect without alerting anyone, quietly returning to his quarters in the Servants' Quarters. Pushing open the door, the familiar musty smell enveloped him - this was proof of his "waste" status, the only person in the entire Tianqing Sect living in such a dilapidated place. But precisely because of this, it had become the safest haven. "Niàn'ér, rest now," Chen Ji gently laid his sister on the bed, tucking her in. In her unconscious state, Chen Nian's brow furrowed, seemingly trapped in nightmares. Chen Ji reached out, clasping her hand gently, whispering, "Brother is here, don't be afraid." Whether by illusion or not, Chen Nian's furrowed brow gradually smoothed.

Once Chen Nian's breathing steadied completely, Chen Ji set a simple alarm formation around her. Then he sat cross-legged by the bed, retrieved the jade slip from Ling Yuan, and probed it again with his divine sense. What he saw made his pupils contract sharply - the contents were far more extraordinary than anticipated. "The Heavenly Secrets' Eye isn't native to this world..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, "It descended from the Void?" According to Ling Yuan's investigation, the Heavenly Secrets' Eye first appeared during a world-altering catastrophe three thousand years ago. It had no physical form, existing merely as pure consciousness, yet could manipulate causality and weave destiny. Every Tianji Record holder throughout history - including Ling Yuan's own master - became its chess piece, ultimately meeting destruction and oblivion.

"Ling Yuan's master..." Chen Ji suddenly recalled, "The Tianji Record mentioned that Ling Yuan was a candidate for the previous generation's Tianji Record inheritance." He closed his eyes, letting his thoughts crystallize. Back then, the Tianji Record had bypassed Ling Yuan, selecting an obscure young man - that must have been his father, or an even earlier ancestor. This betrayal's resentment drove Ling Yuan onto an entirely different path. He didn't seek to obtain the Tianji Record, but instead began researching how to oppose its creator - the Heavenly Secrets' Eye. "Interesting..." Chen Ji opened his eyes, a cold smile curling his lips, "So this old fox has always been playing an enormous game." He stored the jade slip away, his gaze falling on Chen Nian, "And you and I, perhaps, are both pieces on his chessboard."

Just then, soft knocking came from the door. Chen Ji's brow furrowed - who could it be at this late hour? He signaled for Chen Nian to continue resting and quietly approached the door, lowering his voice: "Who is it?" A familiar female voice came from outside: "It's me, Su Qingyao." Chen Ji's heart tightened. This woman's senses were too keen. Though tonight's battle occurred at the Holy Sect, as Tianqing Sect's Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, she had likely already detected the anomaly. "Senior Sister Su, your late-night visit - may I ask what brings you here?" Chen Ji kept the door shut, maintaining vigilance. Silence stretched outside, then Su Qingyao's voice emerged again, carrying complex undertones: "I know you're inside. Chen Ji, tonight's events... I've learned everything." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes. How much did this woman actually know?

text.content: Chen Ji didn't return directly to Tianqing Sect. Instead, he chose another direction - carrying Chen Nian, he arrived at a secluded valley on the edge of Holy Sect ruins. Here stood a seemingly ordinary rock, carved with an inconspicuous rune. Chen Ji pressed his palm against the rune, softly chanting an ancient incantation. Moments later, the rune flickered with faint black light, and a transmission streaked into the distance. Half an hour later, a black-cloaked figure silently materialized in the valley. It was Ye Qing. "Chen Ji?" She gazed at his disheveled state, a flash of surprise crossing her eyes, "What happened to you...?" Chen Ji made no attempt at concealment, briefly explaining tonight's encounter. Upon hearing that the Law Enforcement Elder had personally intervened, Ye Qing's brow knit tightly: "That old bastard... Why would he strike at you two?"

"It's a long story." Chen Ji forced a bitter smile, briefly mentioning Chen Nian's existence and her relationship with the Tianji Record. After hearing this, Ye Qing fell silent for a long while. When she spoke again, her voice carried a hint of solemnity: "Heavenly Fate Key... I've seen this term in the Holy Sect's secret classics." Chen Ji's heart lurched: "You know about it?" Ye Qing nodded: "Legend has it that the Heavenly Fate Key is an extremely special constitution. It can interfere with the operation of Heavenly Secrets-type treasures, preventing them from accurately foreseeing futures involving the 'Key'." She looked at Chen Nian, a complex glint flickering in her eyes, "More importantly... it's said the Heavenly Fate Key is the key to opening a certain 'door'." Chen Ji pressed further: "What door?" Ye Qing shook her head: "The secret classics have no detailed records. But I suspect... it may be related to the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

"The Eye of Heavenly Dao?" Chen Ji's gaze sharpened. "You know about the Eye of Heavenly Dao?" Ye Qing hesitated for a moment, then nodded: "In the Holy Sect's forbidden lands, there are sealed scriptures. They record the true purpose of the Holy Sect's founding—they've been trying to establish contact with the Eye of Heavenly Dao." She paused, lowering her voice further, "And the method of contact is using the Heavenly Fate Key to open that 'door'." A chill ran down Chen Ji's spine. He recalled the Supreme Elder's resolute pursuit, the greed in his eyes when he saw Chen Nian—so from the very beginning, Chen Nian had been targeted by the Holy Sect. She wasn't just the sister he needed to protect; she was the key tool the Holy Sect sought for the Eye of Heavenly Dao. "Holy Sect..." Chen Ji murmured, a killing intent flickering in his eyes, "One day, I'll uproot them entirely." Watching his expression, Ye Qing suddenly said softly: "You've changed."

"Changed?" Chen Ji was startled. Ye Qing walked closer to him, her dark eyes shimmering with an ethereal light under the moonlight: "Before, you always had that serene and indifferent look, as if nothing concerned you. But now..." She reached out and gently tapped Chen Ji's chest. "There's a fire burning here." Chen Ji fell silent. Ye Qing was right. Everything that happened tonight made him truly realize—he thought he was playing chess, but in truth, he was merely struggling on a much larger board. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, the Holy Sect, Ling Yuan... these people and forces were all using him as a chess piece. But now, he refused to be a chess piece any longer. "Ye Qing," he spoke, his voice calm yet resolute, "I need your help. Not just to escape the Holy Sect's pursuit, but to..." He gazed into the distance, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes, "Overturn this chess game." Ye Qing stared at him in a daze, then suddenly smiled—that smile carried a hint of appreciation, a hint of anticipation. "That's more like it. As a Holy Sect Demoness, I love watching righteous cultivators' counterattacks when driven to the brink."

Ye Qing retrieved a black token from her sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji: "This is the guest elder token of the Holy Sect of Demons. In critical moments, it can help you contact me." Chen Ji took the token but furrowed his brow: "This thing..." Ye Qing knew what he was about to say, so she continued: "Are you worried about exposing your identity? Don't worry, this token has been specially processed and can be completely concealed by Demonic Path miasma. As long as you're near me, no one will discover your connection to the Demonic Path." She paused, then added, "Moreover, a strand of my origin power is sealed within the token. In critical moments, it can block a lethal attack for you." Chen Ji gazed at the token in his hand, a complex mix of emotions rising in his heart. This woman, clearly a Holy Sect Demoness, clearly just an exchange of interests with him, yet time and again helped him. "Ye Qing," he spoke, his voice somewhat low, "Thank you." Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then turned her head away, her voice somewhat unnatural: "What are you thanking me for? We're partners."

The atmosphere grew somewhat awkward. Chen Ji quickly changed the subject: "By the way, what else do you know about the Eye of Heavenly Dao?" Ye Qing also seized the opportunity to shift topics, returning to her usual composure: "As I said, the Holy Sect has been trying to contact the Eye of Heavenly Dao. According to my investigation, this contact seems related to a certain ritual, requiring numerous sacrifices—" She glanced at Chen Nian. "Including the Heavenly Fate Key." Chen Ji's heart tightened: "Sacrifices? What do you mean?" Ye Qing shook her head: "I don't know the specifics either. But I know that once the ritual is completed, the Eye of Heavenly Dao will completely descend into this world. By then..." She didn't finish, but the implication was clear. Chen Ji took a deep breath and held Chen Nian tighter: "It seems I need to quicken my pace." Ye Qing nodded: "What do you need me to do?" Chen Ji contemplated for a moment: "Can you monitor the Holy Sect's movements? I need to know their next plan." Ye Qing毫不犹豫地点头: "没问题。三天内，我会把消息传给你。"

After watching Ye Qing depart, Chen Ji stood alone in the valley, the night wind billowing his robes. In his arms, Chen Nian remained unconscious, but her breathing had stabilized considerably. "Nian'er," he murmured softly, "Whatever they want, your brother won't let them succeed." He gazed up at the night sky, countless stars twinkling, yet he could see no destiny belonging to him. "The Tianji Record says that every time I use my foresight ability, I consume Heavenly Fate." He murmured to himself, "But if I don't use it, I can't see the path ahead." This was a dead end—a trap he must constantly deplete himself to survive. But Chen Ji never feared dead ends. A cold smile curved his lips as he turned and flew toward the Tianqing Sect. No matter how perilous the road ahead, he would walk it step by step. Because behind him stood those he needed to protect; in that endless darkness lay the chessboard waiting for him to overturn. In the night, his silhouette cut through the air like a lone sword, flying toward an unknown fate.

Shortly after Chen Ji departed, a black figure emerged from the shadows. He was a scout from the Holy Sect who had witnessed Chen Ji's meeting with Ye Qing. He made no move to intervene, merely silently recording everything before dissolving into a wisp of black smoke vanishing into the horizon. "Report to the Supreme Elder—" his voice echoed through the void. "The target has contacted the Holy Sect Demoness and appears to be planning something. Additionally..." His voice paused. "That废物 Outer Disciple may not be as simple as we assumed." In a secret chamber thousands of miles away, a withered old man slowly opened his eyes. A sinister smile curled at the Supreme Elder's lips: "Interesting... this chess game grows more fascinating by the moment." He raised his hand, and a vertical pupil materialized in his palm—the illusory form of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, cold and terrifying. "Do you young ones think you can break free from the board?" His voice carried the chill of the Nine Nether Abyss. "Under Heaven's gaze, all struggle is futile."

As Chen Ji contemplated, knocking came at the door once more, this time more urgent. "Chen Ji, I know you're in there." Su Qingyao's voice carried a thread of anxiety. "I'm not here to interrogate what you did tonight; I only want to know—are you alright?" Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then rose and opened the door. Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao wore a pure white sword robe, her beautiful face etched with worry. Her gaze first landed on Chen Ji's pallid face, her brow furrowing even tighter. "You're injured?" She reached out, as if to examine Chen Ji's wounds, but stopped just before touching him. "I..." She withdrew her hand, her expression complex. "You're always like this, never willing to tell me anything."

Chen Ji looked at her and suddenly laughed softly: "Senior Sister Su, visiting so late at night, just to ask this?" Su Qingyao glared at him: "Don't play dumb with me. Tonight the Holy Sect made such a huge commotion; the entire Tianqing Sect sensed that Nascent Soul-level pressure. You think I don't know you went there?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his face maintained an innocent expression: "This disciple did indeed go to the Holy Sect, but to save my sister..." He paused, feigning hesitation. "Senior Sister Su, this is a long story, and... rather inconvenient." Su Qingyao stared at him for a long while, then sighed: "I knew you'd say this." She retrieved a jade bottle from her sleeve and pressed it into Chen Ji's hand. "This is a healing elixir I borrowed from the Scripture Repository. It's remarkably effective for repairing Mental Sea damage. You... take care of yourself first."

Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the jade bottle in his hand, momentarily dazed. This woman, despite being repeatedly deflected by him countless times, still came time and again to care for him. "Senior Sister Su," he spoke, his voice several degrees softer than usual, "Why do you always... treat me so well?" Su Qingyao was stunned, then quickly turned her head away. Under the moonlight, her ear tips were slightly flushed: "Wh-who's being good to you? I simply don't want to see anyone in the sect get hurt." Chen Ji couldn't help but smile. This woman, stubborn on the outside but soft within, completely at odds with her cold, hard exterior. "Then thank you, Senior Sister Su." He put away the jade bottle, his expression growing more serious. "Senior Sister, regarding tonight's events, I can't elaborate. But I can tell you one thing—" He met Su Qingyao's eyes, speaking each word distinctly, "Someone within the Tianqing Sect is plotting in the shadows. I'm merely one of the chess pieces."

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply. She was an intelligent person and naturally understood the deeper meaning behind Chen Ji's words. "Are you saying... Master Ling?" Chen Ji offered no answer, only giving her a meaningful glance. "This..." Su Qingyao momentarily didn't know what to say. Ling Yuan was the former Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect, highly respected—how could he possibly... Yet connecting Chen Ji's experiences over the years with the legend of the Tianji Record, a terrifying speculation took shape in her mind. "Chen Ji," she took a deep breath, "If you tell me this, aren't you afraid I'll leak it?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Senior Sister Su is a wise person; naturally she knows what to say and what not to." He paused, lowering his voice. "Moreover... I need someone I can trust." Su Qingyao gazed at him in a daze, her heartbeat suddenly accelerating. In the eyes of this "waste of a junior brother," there now shimmered a light she had never seen before—the sedimentation of someone who had survived the brink of despair, the serenity after seeing through everything, and even... some indescribable emotion.

After a long while, Su Qingyao finally收回目光,轻声说道:"好，我记住了。" She turned to leave but paused at the threshold, her back to him: "Chen Ji, whatever secrets you carry, I..." Her voice hesitated,似乎在鼓起勇气, "我会站在你这边的。"说完，她化作一道白光消失在夜色中。Chen Ji stood at the doorway, gazing at her departing direction, motionless for a long time. "Will stand on my side, you say..." he murmured to himself, a complex smile forming at his lips. "Su Qingyao, do you know what it means to be drawn into this game?" He turned back into the room and looked at Chen Nian, still unconscious on the bed: "Nian'er, this game your brother is playing... is growing ever larger." Outside the window, the night was deep and dark as ink. In the distant sky, a meteor streaked across the heavens, vanishing in an instant. And in the depths of a forbidden land thousands of miles away, a pair of transcendent eyes slowly opened, gazing upon this land—watching Chen Ji's every move. The Eye of Heavenly Dao had already sensed the anomalous fluctuations of the Tianji Record. And the chess game it had set in motion was only just beginning.
